semantics: Tri-state per capability: SUPPORTED / UNSUPPORTED / UNKNOWN. UNKNOWN is NOT FALSE — any REQUIRED capability that is UNKNOWN fails closed. Provider absence never contaminates GenericRuntime.

fields.supports_partial_fill_reporting: UNKNOWN (no official partial-fill reporting contract observed)
fields.supports_modify_order: UNKNOWN (cancel+replace is the safe policy until official modify contract is verified)
fields.supports_client_order_id: UNSUPPORTED (strategyId is an ownership TAG, not a client order id; durable ledger is idempotency authority)
fields.supports_hedging: UNKNOWN (per-account accounting mode; not asserted without account truth)
fields.supports_netting: UNKNOWN (deprecated netting param in official client; not asserted)
fields.supports_order_check: UNSUPPORTED (no broker-side preflight endpoint; adapter performs LOCAL structural preflight only, zero network)
fields.supports_multi_account_session: SUPPORTED (one authenticated session, many authorized accounts via /auth/jwt/all-accounts)
fields.supports_history: SUPPORTED (/trade/history, resolution-based, bounded by QUOTES_HISTORY_BARS limit)

provider_truth.mt5: Declared by MT5BrokerSession per injected module (R2 frozen); NOT modified by R5.
provider_truth.tradelocker: As above, frozen from official client source at 2026-08-18.
provider_truth.sim: Full capability surface for deterministic harness.

fail_closed_rule: GenericRuntime must call capabilities().require(cap, what) before any path that depends on a capability; UNKNOWN and UNSUPPORTED both block.
